description: Kotlin ViewModel class for managing product list data including search, filtering, and pagination in an online shopping platform.

classes.name: ProductListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing product search, filters, and pagination state for the product list UI.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query state, triggering a data refresh.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Updates the category filter and triggers a new data fetch.

methods.name: setMinPriceCents
methods.description: Sets the minimum price filter and updates the product list accordingly.

methods.name: setMaxPriceCents
methods.description: Sets the maximum price filter and updates the product list accordingly.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to default values and refreshes product data.
